title: Average without truncation
prompt: Implement `double averageOfFour(int a, int b, int c, int d)`: the mean of four ints. Beware: `a + b + c + d / 4` is wrong twice — precedence AND integer division. Cast the **sum** to double before dividing.

tests.name: exact mean
tests.hint: (double) (a + b + c + d) / 4 — cast before divide, not after.
